# jsQR 1.4.0

QR code decoder used by the field app when the browser has no `BarcodeDetector` (Safari on iPhone, Chrome on desktop).

- Source: npm package `jsqr` 1.4.0, file `dist/jsQR.js` (https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR)
